photos.desc: Calvia quatuordecimguttata (Linnaeus, 1758). Utterslev Mose, Søborg, Denmark, 25 July 2015
Four common and slightly similar looking "Bambi"-like ladybirds of Europe. Calvia decemguttata, Adalia decempunctata, Halyzia sedecimguttata and Calvia quatuordecimguttata .
Calvia quattuordecimguttata (Linnæus, 1758). Body length 5.3 mm without antennae. Determined by kerbtier.de. Germany: Niedersachsen, 1 km W of Diemarden near Göttingen.
Cream-spot ladybird, Calvia quatuordecimguttata , Location: Germany, District of Ortenau, Nordrach
Calvia quattuordecimguttata (Linnæus, 1758). Germany: S Bayern, Landkreis Bad Tölz, Walchensee, Zwergern peninsula, 810 m.
